description: Fetch app metadata and recent user reviews for a Google Play or iOS App Store app by store URL, Apple numeric id or Google Play package name, filtered by country, language, date and sort order. Use when the user wants to know what customers complain about or praise. Returns one app row (title, developer, rating, rating count, version) followed by review rows (rating, text, date, app version, helpful votes, developer reply). Apple's public reviews feed is sometimes empty; the app then returns its metadata plus an error row with code "unavailable" instead of reviews. Reviewer identity is never included.

apps.description: App Store or Google Play URLs, Apple numeric ids (id310633997) or Play package names (com.spotify.music)

languages.description: Google Play language codes. Defaults to ["en"]

maxReviewsPerApp.description: Reviews per app, country and language. Default 100, 0 returns app metadata only

sinceDate.description: ISO date; only reviews on or after it

name: get_app_reviews
